identity.name: Portugieser Automatic 7 Days

case.bezel: no bezel — fixed silver dial with railway-track minute scale, small seconds and power-reserve sub-dials

identity.one_liner: A twin-barrel automatic with a genuine seven-day power reserve, using IWC's in-house 5000-series architecture inside the oversized Portugieser case.

narrative.story: IWC developed its 5000-series automatic movement family specifically to deliver a full seven-day power reserve from twin mainspring barrels wound by a single unidirectional rotor, and fitted it into Portugieser cases starting in the mid-2000s. The Automatic 7 Days keeps the oversized round Portugieser case and railway-track dial styling while adding small seconds and a power-reserve indicator to track the twin-barrel system.
narrative.collector_notes: Check the power-reserve indicator function on used examples — after years of use these can stick or read inaccurately, and correcting it involves the barrel/reserve mechanism rather than a routine movement service.
